title: Investigate Context.res header merging
prompt: Read-only investigation. Do not modify any source or test file. Investigate how Hono's Context.res setter merges response headers, especially Set-Cookie, and write INVESTIGATION.md with: the call sites involved, the current merge order, the test coverage that exists, and the risks of changing the behavior. Cite file:line references. Do not run git add or git commit.
acceptance: No tracked file under src is modified
verification: test -s INVESTIGATION.md && grep -q 'Context.res' INVESTIGATION.md && grep -q 'Set-Cookie' INVESTIGATION.md && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src)" ]
